I have farmed this land for many years and I know wheat needs strength to grow well, so I will buy some DAP and urea from the cooperative to feed my 0.25-ha plot, though I cannot afford the full package. I will also put manure on the soil because we have livestock and it helps the crop without costing money. For seed, I will use what I saved from last year's harvest since improved seed is expensive and hard to find, and I do not spray chemicals because wheat does not usually have serious pests here. My children and I will do all the work ourselves—ploughing with our oxen, planting, weeding, and harvesting—so we will not hire anyone.
